skill_name: Explain the difference between a bar chart and a line chart.
workflow: A bar chart is a chart that compares values across categories by using bars of different heights. Each bar typically represents the sum or average of all the data in the category it represents. A line chart, on the other hand, is a chart that displays the changes in the value of one or more variables over time, typically on an x-axis. Line charts can be used to show trends in data over time, or to compare multiple sets of data. Whereas bar charts indicate the magnitude of the data being measured
